none: PAS NLM-B87F9A: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 335-337, Trier mint, Reece period 17; RIC volume 7 no. 589. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTI]NOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory on prow advancing left. In exergue: TRP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.3mm, Weight: 1.46gms, die axis: 6
